description.value:
You served your home settlement's law enforcement, standing as its first line of defense against crime rather than external threats. Whether the settlement was a sprawling ecumenopolis or a single frontier outpost, your job was keeping the peace among its own people.

The discipline of that service stuck with you, and so did the ability to spot a den of criminal activity or find the local watch outpost in almost any town you walk into, welcome or not.

system.equipment: A uniform in the style of your unit indicating your rank, a horn with which to summon help, a set of binders, and a pouch containing 100 credits.
